description: jQuery UI Resizable widget implementation, enabling resize functionality for DOM elements with configuration options, event handling, and plugin extensions.

classes.name: ui.resizable
classes.description: A jQuery UI widget that adds resize capabilities to elements.

methods.name: _create
methods.description: Initializes the resizable widget, setting up handles, wrapping elements if necessary, and event handlers.

methods.name: _destroy
methods.description: Cleans up the widget, removing event handlers and DOM modifications.

methods.name: _setOption
methods.description: Updates widget options dynamically.

methods.name: _setupHandles
methods.description: Creates and renders resize handles based on configuration.

methods.name: _removeHandles
methods.description: Removes resize handles from DOM.

methods.name: _mouseCapture
methods.description: Determines if a mousedown event targets a resize handle.

methods.name: _mouseStart
methods.description: Begins resize operation, recording initial sizes and positions.

methods.name: _mouseDrag
methods.description: Handles the resize operation during mouse movement, updating size and position.

methods.name: _mouseStop
methods.description: Ends resize operation, finalizing size and cleanup.

methods.name: _updatePrevProperties
methods.description: Stores previous position and size before resize.

methods.name: _applyChanges
methods.description: Applies calculated size and position changes to the element.

methods.name: _updateVirtualBoundaries
methods.description: Calculates boundaries for resizing based on options like min/max size and aspect ratio.

methods.name: _updateCache
methods.description: Updates internal cache of size and position.

methods.name: _updateRatio
methods.description: Maintains aspect ratio during resize if enabled.

methods.name: _respectSize
methods.description: Ensures resize stays within min/max size boundaries.

methods.name: _getPaddingPlusBorderDimensions
methods.description: Calculates total padding and border dimensions of an element.

methods.name: _calculateAdjustedElementDimensions
methods.description: Calculates element dimensions considering box-sizing and scroll.

methods.name: _getElementTheoreticalSize
methods.description: Computes theoretical size of an element based on offset dimensions.

methods.name: _proportionallyResize
methods.description: Resizes related elements proportionally.

methods.name: _renderProxy
methods.description: Creates a proxy element for resize visualization.

methods.name: _change
methods.description: Contains functions to calculate size changes for each resize handle.

methods.name: _propagate
methods.description: Triggers widget events and plugins.

methods.name: ui
methods.description: Returns current UI state including element, helper, position, size, etc.
